summary: Frontend-only verification of the DENSITY tab bug fix in the Feed Program (Broiler Base Mate) desktop app. Tested Farm Buddy age-based breed-standard weight estimate fallback in DensityView across all 4 seeded farms (default, north-creek, southridge, eaglehawk). All acceptance criteria pass — the fix correctly replaces the buggy birds/m² fallback with a proper kg/m² live-weight density derived from Ross 308 breed standards when no override/weigh-in/catch weight exists yet.

tests_executed.id: TEST 1 — estimate fallback appears with correct Ross 308 age-based weight
tests_executed.detail: All 12 sheds on every seeded farm render the new '🧠 Farm Buddy estimate: X.XXX kg · day N (Ross 308) — enter today's weight for accuracy' badge (data-testid=density-estimate-badge-{shedNum}). Seeded farms have ages day 169/172/175 which cap at Ross 308 ~4.067 kg — Farm Buddy correctly derives this from placement date. NOTE: no seeded farm currently has a day 3-10 batch to exactly reproduce the original bug scenario, but the estimate-based kg/m² calculation chain was verified end-to-end (see TEST 2).

tests_executed.id: TEST 2 — kg/m² live-weight now uses the estimate (not raw birds/m²)
tests_executed.detail: Set Shed 1 (north-creek, 40,500 birds) to 2000 m² shed size. Card correctly displays 82.4 kg/m² (= 20.3 birds/m² × 4.067 kg estimate) with red Baiada-max alert and 'Remove ~27,714 birds' recommendation. The fill bar and color logic now correctly derive from primaryVal (kg/m²) instead of raw birds/m². For a hypothetical day-5 shed (0.151 kg/bird) at the same 20.3 birds/m², kg/m² would be 3.06 → GREEN, exactly matching the user's expectation. Verified via TEST 3 override that same 20.3 birds/m² @ 0.15 kg → 3.0 kg/m² GREEN.

tests_executed.id: TEST 3 — manual today's weight override still takes priority
tests_executed.detail: Typed '0.15' into density-today-wt-input-1. Card recalculated live to 3.0 kg/m² GREEN, override badge (density-override-badge-1) shows '✍️ using today's weight: 0.150 kg', estimate badge disappears (count=0). Fill bar and coloring update immediately without reload.

tests_executed.id: TEST 4 — clearing override restores the estimate
tests_executed.detail: Clicking density-clear-today-wt-1 clears the input; estimate badge reappears (count=1), override badge disappears (count=0).
Default farm sheds (with 0 placed birds) render '—' for kg/m² and still show the estimate badge based on placement date. No console errors, no crash.
Code review confirms priority chain overrideKg ?? latestWeighInKg ?? latestCatchWgtKg ?? estimatedKg in App.tsx L6458. TEST 3 already proves higher-priority sources correctly displace the estimate.

tests_executed.id: TEST 7 — smoke: no console errors on Density tab
tests_executed.detail: Zero console errors across navigation to Density tab on all 4 farms and during input/override interactions.

critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is 14,122 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; consider splitting DensityView, FlockForecastView etc. into their own modules for maintainability. Not a blocker for this fix.

groupEstimates memo depends on [sheets, edits, shedBreeds] but shedBreeds is only initialised from localStorage once (useState without update); if a user changes breed in Flock Forecast, DensityView will not recompute the estimate until page reload. Minor — add a storage-event listener like the one already used for FLOCK_WEIGHIN_KEY / BATCH_CATCHES_KEY.

The estimate badge shows breed via BREED_DAILY[getShedBreedKey(groupId, slot)]?.name — this uses groupId as the sgId argument but earlier in groupEstimates the sgId is derived from SHED_SHEET_ORDER[shedCount]. If those diverge for non-contiguous shed layouts, badge could show the wrong breed name. Not observed on seeded farms but worth checking.
test_credentials: Owner magic link used per request; session cookie persisted after visiting /api/auth/owner-magic then navigating to /?farm=<slug>.
seed_data_creation: None. Wrote transient localStorage entries via UI (shed size = 2000 for north-creek Shed 1, today's weight = 0.15 kg) — should be cleared by user/main agent if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DensityView estimate fix is verified working. Seeded farms only have late-stage (day 169-175) batches, so testing a true day-5 scenario requires either (a) creating a fresh farm/batch with today's placement date, or (b) editing the placement date on a seeded shed via the Summary tab. Current tests confirm the calculation chain (birds/m² × estimated kg = primary kg/m²) works correctly at any weight value.
rca of the issue: Original bug (verified fixed): DensityView fell back to coloring the bar using raw birds/m² thresholds (green<10, amber<14, red>=14) when no weigh-in existed, causing normally-stocked young sheds (~18 birds/m²) to be flagged red as 'breaking density'. Fix adds a Ross 308 / Cobb 500 daily-weight estimate (via new groupEstimates memo using findPlacementDate + stdAtBreed) as the last-resort fallback in latestKg, so the true kg/m² live-weight density is used everywhere. Verified: day-175 sheds now show 4.067 kg estimate and correctly high kg/m²; the same 20.3 birds/m² at 0.15 kg (simulated day-5 weight via manual override) produces 3.0 kg/m² GREEN — no false red.
